finding: The native checks do NOT inherit fact-level flags onto items. tools/belt/checks/06-exam-bank.mjs NEEDS_REVIEW_ZERO reads only item.needs_review===true on served items and requires an honest needs_review_count of 0; SELF_FLAGGED_RESOLVED reads only item.self_flagged and the self_flagged_distractors list. Neither check reads fact_registry flags, verification_debt, dynamic markers or source debt. Bank-wide source debt (stale edition, unverified exam facts) therefore flags no item by itself. The premise that required flagged facts must retain item-level needs_review is not in the contract: prompts/06.md line 20 prescribes one item per studied card where the bank allows a SOUND item, with TYPED GAPS otherwise.
contract_compatible_path: 1. item.needs_review is the AUTHOR's own unresolved concern about that item. Resolve it (rewrite the stem/options against the accepted statement) or do not serve the item: record a typed gap (coverage gap with reason) for that node instead. Acceptance requires zero served flagged items by contract (release control, unchanged).

2. Dynamic or low-confidence facts (fees, phone numbers, statistics, dated penalties): quarantine them at 03 as dynamic nodes (the knowledge graph's dynamic-node list), so no card, item or lesson is required for them. Precedent: North Carolina quarantined sec01-F03/F04, sec03-F15, sec04-F32, sec05-F31 (round 1) and sec10-F24, sec13-F03, sec16-F44/F47 (round 2) this way; Connecticut and Nevada similar.

3. High-yield facts that the high-yield check will not let you quarantine: author the item on the stable rule the fact states (the obligation, not the dollar figure or date), keep needs_review false, and name the dynamic value in the fact's existing dossier debt (part D / verification_debt) — precedent: NC sec05-F47/R12 fees, CO/TX penalty facts.

4. Fact-level truth concerns stay where the contract puts them: 02 part D debts and the 08 fact audit (which has not run on any state yet). Nothing in 06 is the place to carry them, and nothing in 06 blocks them.
5. 05.sessions require an accepted bank (context.mjs); with steps 1–3 the bank accepts, so the dependency is satisfied without a serving-state split.
first_confirm: Before changing anything, list DE's items with needs_review:true and, for each, whether the flag is item-specific (author doubt about stem/options) or a copy of a fact-level debt. In every Claude-authored state this number was zero at acceptance because flags were resolved or the node quarantined/gapped; expect the same here.
not_granted: a draft-vs-serving quarantine state in schemas-strict/06-exambank.schema.json or the mapping (contract/schema change: needs a founder AMENDMENT-ORDER with APPROVED-BY, and it is not needed for DE)
